WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName AS product_name,
       SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM qualifying_customers)
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews as pageviews,
    totals.transactions as transactions,
    MAX(p.productRevenue) as max_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, date, totals.pageviews, totals.transactions
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
  WHERE (transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL)
     OR (transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL)
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  session_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pageviews), 2) as avg_pageviews
FROM classified
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH inpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_id,
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_inpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_id,
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_outpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(i.provider_id, o.provider_id) as provider_id,
  COALESCE(i.provider_name, o.provider_name) as provider_name,
  i.avg_inpatient_cost,
  o.avg_outpatient_cost,
  COALESCE(i.avg_inpatient_cost, 0) + COALESCE(o.avg_outpatient_cost, 0) as combined_avg_cost
FROM inpatient_avg i
FULL OUTER JOIN outpatient_avg o ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    nppes_provider_state as state,
    SUM(total_claim_count) as total_claim_count,
    SUM(total_drug_cost) as total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE all_desc AS (
    SELECT 'L70' as icd_code, 141095 as snomed_concept_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'L20' as icd_code, 133834 as snomed_concept_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'L40' as icd_code, 140168 as snomed_concept_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'L80' as icd_code, 138502 as snomed_concept_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.icd_code, cr.concept_id_2
    FROM all_desc d
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
      ON d.snomed_concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
      AND cr.concept_id_2 IN (
        SELECT concept_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED'
      )
),
condition_snomed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT icd_code, snomed_concept_id FROM all_desc
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
),
person_counts AS (
    SELECT cs.icd_code, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) as person_count
    FROM condition_snomed cs
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
      ON cs.snomed_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    GROUP BY cs.icd_code
),
condition_names AS (
    SELECT 'L70' as icd_code, 'Acne' as condition_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'L20', 'Atopic dermatitis'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'L40', 'Psoriasis'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'L80', 'Vitiligo'
)
SELECT cn.icd_code, cn.condition_name, pc.person_count,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(pc.person_count, t.total_count) * 100 as percentage
FROM person_counts pc
JOIN condition_names cn ON pc.icd_code = cn.icd_code
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY cn.icd_code

WITH all_data AS (
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
),
monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air_temp,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wet_bulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dew_point,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM all_data
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  ROUND(ABS(avg_air_temp - avg_wet_bulb) + 
  ABS(avg_air_temp - avg_dew_point) + 
  ABS(avg_air_temp - avg_sst) + 
  ABS(avg_wet_bulb - avg_dew_point) + 
  ABS(avg_wet_bulb - avg_sst) + 
  ABS(avg_dew_point - avg_sst), 4) AS sum_abs_diffs
FROM monthly_avgs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diffs ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    (CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS temp_c,
    CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) * 2.54 AS prcp_cm,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '998009'
    AND year = '2019'
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND prcp != 99.99
    AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag8_diff
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 END) as max_precipitation_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 END) as min_temperature_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 END) as max_temperature_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
  AND id = 'USW00094846'
  AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  AND qflag IS NULL
  AND value IS NOT NULL
  AND date >= DATE_SUB(DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING), '-12-31')), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH 
live_1995 AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as species_key, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995
  WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) FROM bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species)
    AND status != 'Dead'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
live_2015 AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as species_key, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015
  WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) FROM bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species)
    AND status = 'Alive'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(l1.species_key, l2.species_key) as species_key,
    COALESCE(l1.cnt, 0) as cnt_1995,
    COALESCE(l2.cnt, 0) as cnt_2015,
    COALESCE(l1.cnt, 0) - COALESCE(l2.cnt, 0) as diff
  FROM live_1995 l1
  FULL OUTER JOIN live_2015 l2 ON l1.species_key = l2.species_key
)
SELECT 
  ts.fall_color,
  SUM(sd.diff) as total_change
FROM species_diff sd
JOIN bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species ts ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = sd.species_key
GROUP BY ts.fall_color
ORDER BY total_change DESC

WITH all_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    mta_tax,
    total_amount,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
    AND fare_amount >= 0
    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0
    AND mta_tax >= 0
    AND total_amount >= 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    mta_tax,
    total_amount,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
    AND fare_amount >= 0
    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0
    AND mta_tax >= 0
    AND total_amount >= 0
),
with_zones AS (
  SELECT 
    a.*,
    pz.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
    dz.zone_name AS dropoff_zone
  FROM all_trips a
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz
    ON a.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz
    ON a.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_zone,
    dropoff_zone,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
    trip_distance,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_distance, SAFE_DIVIDE(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND), 3600.0)) AS driving_speed_mph,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 AS tip_rate_pct,
    total_amount
  FROM with_zones
  WHERE total_amount > 0
)
SELECT 
  pickup_zone,
  dropoff_zone,
  trip_duration_seconds,
  driving_speed_mph,
  tip_rate_pct
FROM with_metrics
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    c.country AS country,
    c.total_confirmed,
    p.population_2020,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.total_confirmed * 100000, p.population_2020) AS cases_per_100k
FROM (
    SELECT 'United States' AS country, SUM(confirmed) as total_confirmed 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` 
    WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'US'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'France', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'France'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'China', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'China'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Italy', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Italy'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Spain', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Spain'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Germany', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Germany'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Iran', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Iran'
) c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 'USA' AS country_code, value AS population_2020 FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'USA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'FRA', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'FRA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CHN', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'CHN' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ITA', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'ITA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ESP', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'ESP' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'DEU', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'DEU' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'IRN', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'IRN' AND year = 2020
) p ON (CASE WHEN c.country = 'United States' THEN 'USA' ELSE c.country END) = p.country_code
ORDER BY c.country

WITH covid AS (
  SELECT 
    county_fips_code,
    TRIM(county_name) AS county_name,
    state,
    confirmed_cases,
    deaths
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.summary`
  WHERE date = '2020-08-27'
    AND county_fips_code != '00000'
),
county_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(geo_id AS INT64) AS fips_int,
    total_pop,
    median_age
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr`
  WHERE total_pop > 50000
)
SELECT 
  c.county_name,
  c.state,
  cp.median_age,
  cp.total_pop,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.confirmed_cases, cp.total_pop) * 100000, 2) AS cases_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.deaths, cp.total_pop) * 100000, 2) AS deaths_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.deaths, c.confirmed_cases) * 100, 2) AS case_fatality_rate_pct
FROM covid c
JOIN county_pop cp ON c.county_fips_code = LPAD(CAST(cp.fips_int AS STRING), 5, '0')
WHERE c.confirmed_cases > 0
ORDER BY case_fatality_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH cal_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income AS median_income_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%' AND median_income IS NOT NULL
),
cal_2018 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income AS median_income_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%' AND median_income IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  a.geo_id,
  a.median_income_2015,
  b.median_income_2018,
  b.median_income_2018 - a.median_income_2015 AS increase
FROM cal_2015 a
JOIN cal_2018 b ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    game_clock,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    event_type,
    period,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    event_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, 
      CASE WHEN event_description LIKE '%free throw 1%' THEN 1 
           WHEN event_description LIKE '%free throw 2%' THEN 2 
           WHEN event_description LIKE '%free throw 3%' THEN 3 
           ELSE 0 END) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc' 
    AND points_scored > 0
)
SELECT 
  s1.game_clock,
  s1.team_name AS scoring_team,
  s1.event_description,
  SAFE_CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s2.team_name = 'Wildcats' THEN s2.points_scored ELSE 0 END) AS INT64) AS wildcats_score,
  SAFE_CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s2.team_name = 'Fighting Irish' THEN s2.points_scored ELSE 0 END) AS INT64) AS fighting_irish_score
FROM scoring_events s1
JOIN scoring_events s2 ON s2.elapsed_time_sec < s1.elapsed_time_sec 
  OR (s2.elapsed_time_sec = s1.elapsed_time_sec AND s2.rn <= s1.rn)
GROUP BY s1.game_clock, s1.team_name, s1.event_description, s1.period, s1.elapsed_time_sec, s1.rn
ORDER BY s1.elapsed_time_sec, s1.rn

-- Check if we should use market instead of name, and verify the top 5 with market
WITH max_wins_per_season AS (
    SELECT season, MAX(wins) as max_wins
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
    WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
      AND market IS NOT NULL
      AND market != ''
    GROUP BY season
),
peak_seasons AS (
    SELECT m.market, m.season, m.wins
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` m
    JOIN max_wins_per_season mw ON m.season = mw.season
    WHERE m.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
      AND m.market IS NOT NULL
      AND m.market != ''
      AND m.wins = mw.max_wins
)
SELECT market, COUNT(*) as peak_seasons_count
FROM peak_seasons
GROUP BY market
ORDER BY peak_seasons_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT industry, subsector, sector, year, total_employed_in_thousands, percent_women, percent_white, percent_black_or_african_american, percent_asian, percent_hispanic_or_latino FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18` WHERE subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53') AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT p.patient_id,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as has_kras,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN k53_mutations m ON p.patient_id = m.patient_id
  GROUP BY p.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 AS INT64)) as a,
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 AS INT64)) as b,
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 AS INT64)) as c,
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 AS INT64)) as d
  FROM patient_status
)
SELECT
  a, b, c, d,
  a+b+c+d as n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(a - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), a+b+c+d))
  + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(b - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), a+b+c+d))
  + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(c - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), a+b+c+d))
  + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(d - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), a+b+c+d))
  as chi_squared_statistic
FROM contingency

WITH rn_freq AS (

    SUM(CASE WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) ELSE 0 END) as gain_freq,

  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
cc_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(c.Chr, 4) as chr_num,
    c.Type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CaseNo) as freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cy ON c.CaseNo = cy.CaseNo
  WHERE cy.Morph = '3111' AND cy.Topo = '0401'
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(c.Chr, 4), c.Type
)
SELECT 
  CORR(rn.gain_freq, cc_g.freq) as gain_correlation,
  CORR(rn.loss_freq, cc_l.freq) as loss_correlation
FROM rn_freq rn
JOIN cc_freq cc_g ON rn.chr_num = cc_g.chr_num AND cc_g.Type = 'Gain'
JOIN cc_freq cc_l ON rn.chr_num = cc_l.chr_num AND cc_l.Type = 'Loss'

WITH event_session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END) AS session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS medium,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'source' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS source,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'campaign' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND ep.key IN ('ga_session_id', 'medium', 'source', 'campaign')
  GROUP BY event_timestamp
),
session_traffic AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    medium,
    source,
    campaign,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM event_session_params
  WHERE medium IS NOT NULL OR source IS NOT NULL
),
session_channel AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign, 'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'baidu|bing|duckduckgo|ecosia|google|yahoo|yandex')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
        OR medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'baidu|bing|duckduckgo|ecosia|google|yahoo|yandex')
        OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'mobile') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_traffic
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM session_channel
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

-- Step 1: Get session_start users in July 2-16
WITH session_start_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM session_start_users
